title: Primer of the Hilt and Point
summary: Teaches the grip, stance and plain thrust of the dagger to an unawakened beginner using body strength alone.

title: A Drill-Book for the Short Blade
summary: Gives a beginner the daily drills for the draw, the point thrust and the first parries of the dagger.

title: The Plain Dagger Handbook
summary: Sets out the carry, draw and basic cuts of the dagger for any body-trained student without qi.

title: Workbook of Close Quarters Steel
summary: Drills a student to fight inside arm's reach with the dagger by footwork, grips and short cuts.

title: Guide to the Reverse Grip
summary: Explains the reverse grip of the dagger and the stabs, blocks and wrist work that suit it.

title: Notes on Carrying and Drawing the Dagger
summary: Covers how to wear, hide and draw the dagger and the first cuts that come from the draw.

title: First Lessons in Inside Fighting
summary: Introduces the first qi-lit footwork and cuts for fighting inside an opponent's guard with a dagger.

title: The Hip-Draw Exercises
summary: Trains a student who has awakened qi to draw and cut from the hip with a thread of qi along the edge.

title: Handbook of the Boot Dagger Draw
summary: Teaches the hidden boot and sleeve carry of the dagger and the draw strokes that follow it.

title: Treatise on Footwork for the Short Blade
summary: Sets out the steps, pivots and retreats a dagger fighter needs to stay inside and out of reach.

title: The Throwing Dagger Drill Sheets
summary: Gives drill sheets for throwing the dagger at short range with a thin push of qi behind the wrist.

title: Common Rules of the Narrow Lane
summary: Explains the guards and stabs that a dagger fighter uses in alleys, stairways and crowded rooms.
